draft.heroMessage: Your Asheville and Black Mountain Real Estate Partners
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Freestone Properties—offering a modern, local approach to real estate in Asheville, Black Mountain and the scenic communities of Western North Carolina.
draft.tagline: Local Roots. Boutique Service. Modern Results.
draft.aboutParagraph: Founded by Scott and Lisa Russell, Freestone Properties is a truly local, boutique real estate firm serving the Asheville and Black Mountain area. Our firm blends years of market expertise and personalized service with the innovative technology and robust resources of the largest real estate company in the Carolinas, through our partnership with Allen Tate/Beverly-Hanks. At Freestone, we believe real estate is more than transactions—it's about connections, local knowledge, and helping our clients navigate the constantly changing landscape of buying and selling homes. We take pride in offering customized strategies, continuous innovation, and a genuinely people-focused experience.
draft.conciergeLine: Have a question or ready to start your real estate journey? Reach out by phone or email for prompt, friendly assistance.
draft.contactLine: Call us at (828) 419-0444 or email realestate@freestoneproperties.com—we're here to help.

sections.body: View all Waynesville homes for sale Waynesville, NC is a town located southwest of Asheville. It’s the county seat of Haywood County and the biggest town west of Asheville before the North Carolina-Tennessee border. In addition to a warm and walkable downtown, the larger Waynesville area also contains quiet neighborhoods and rural communities. It is considered part of the Asheville metropolitan area, being only 45 minutes from the Asheville city center.
